en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo steamship sailing on a calm waterway. The vessel has a single funnel with the letters "KIA" on it and a tall superstructure amidships. The ship's name "MARIENBURG" is visible on the bow or stern area. Reeds are visible in the foreground along the shore; the background is mostly empty sky and faint horizon. The image has the framing and style of a vintage maritime postcard.
